reviews.title: Get it
reviews.text: This app is amazing. I’m an ADHD mom with three kids under 5. Due to my husband’s work schedule, I’m usually alone in the mornings trying to get my three kids out the door and to preschool/daycare before I head to work. Mornings were HORRIBLE. We were running late every morning, no matter what I did. It was not uncommon for me to leave the house in tears. This app has definitely helped keep me on track and also helped me identify which tasks were taking too long in the morning. Additionally, I made a nighttime routine that helps me stay focused, as I often go to bed ridiculously late. I’ve tried so many productivity apps but this is a keeper. If mornings are a nightmare or you struggle to go to bed at a reasonable time, get this app!! I will never go back!

reviews.title: New update ruined the whole app
reviews.text: I have been a dedicated, paying user of this app for over two years. I use it every night to schedule my next day, and it has been more effective than any anxiety medication I’ve tried in 10 years. I recommend it to every single friend and have shown it to several therapists and health professionals to try and get it more widespread. This app is maybe the most important part of my mental health and wellbeing. This most recent update destroyed it. Nothing is where it used to be, and it completely deleted a routine that I use every single day because I set it to “do not repeat” thinking that would move it to the “lightning” tab where my other unscheduled routine is. Instead, it got rid of a routine that I spent months perfecting, and then months relying on. Also, when you create a routine, they got rid of the feature that gives you the option to add the same tasks you’ve made before. For an app entirely based around routine, changing the entire UI without asking the user beforehand or offering the old version is a huge issue, and I may have to try to find/program a different system if I can’t overcome this problem, which is devastating.

reviews.title: Was a useful app until last update

Original review: This app has been quite useful in helping me improve things in my life. 

But unfortunately, with this last update they’ve done, they seem to have decided that resetting my routine at midnight every night is the best way to go about things. My important routine happens in that crossover from one day to the next. So while I am trying to wrap things up with my routine, the whole routine resets, even though the routine is showing it lasts until 2 AM. So the last week has been quite frustrating as I have not been able to finish my routine each time. If this continues, I don’t see how this is gonna help with motivation and productivity.

If it weren’t for this latest update, I would’ve given this rating five stars. But with this update, it now makes the app nearly useless for me. I have searched and searched through the settings and there seems to be no way that I can make it go back to the way it was before. Please help. I’ll be happy to change my rating if it gets fixed.

reviews.text:
Updated review after developer response: The startup process for lifetime membership was a little rough, but the developer corrected the issue and provided a thoughtful and candid response here. The app and its features are helpful and really make a difference in my daily routines and life tasks. I appreciate the value it provides as well as the developer’s seemingly genuine and sincere response (not corporate Newspeak). 

Initial review: 
Going to leave this here until I receive a response to my support email. App dev offers a lifetime membership through its website, but uses a fulfillment service that drops the ball. No receipt or payment confirmation by email. 

No update or change in the subscription settings of the app. No contact number for either dev or fulfillment service. 

Emailed developer; no response. Tried to “chat” with fulfiller’s automated/ai verification gatekeeper that says it can’t find a transaction for my email address, but then shows my email address when I “try another way” by providing payment amount, transaction date, card number, etc. After that, it says it is sending me a verification email but never does (not in spam or anywhere else; tried multiple times). 

Transaction already posted to Apple Card (paid by Apple Pay). That seems to be the only part that worked; imagine that. 

Too bad; I like the functionality of the app even more than a few others that have been app of the day/year/design award winners/etc. That’s why I opted for the lifetime subscription. At least one of the others also offers a lifetime subscription, and it looks like I may have to move on that way.

reviews.title: Completely worth it. Amazing app for ADHD brains
reviews.text: This app is one of the most useful tools I've ever used to combat procrastination and other ADHD related difficulties. I love how flexible it is to be able to adapt to what I specifically need. I especially love that I can skip a part of my routine and it still marks the entire routine as completed (you can see in the details what you skipped). This is a big deal for me because it removes the feeling of missing something and the guilt that could entail. People often say "just start" but it feels like every part of a bigger task needs that decision to start. With this app, I just need to decide to start the routine, the rest is decided. It's gotten me to be more consistent with my workouts (I just added 15 minutes of yoga to the end of my morning routine) and with my studies. But I use it for anything I do regularly that involves more than two sequential actions. The big thing is, YOU need to decide start. The app can remind you, but only you have the power to take that action. But once you've done that, the app (and your past self who created the routine) removes the decision fatigue from the rest of that routine. I seriously and wholeheartedly recommend this app!

reviews.title: They ruined it.
reviews.text: This app is garbage now. They changed the alarm so that it now only plays sound instead of making your phone vibrate. They also changed the alarm notification to look like an actual alarm, meaning you can just shut it off. The appeal of Routinery for me was that the alarm would push constant notifs to my phone and make it buzz with no way to turn it off except to start the routine. That always forced me to remember what I need to do. Without that, I know I'll just end up dismissing or missing entirely the notifs the app sends. It's useless now. Im canceling my subscription after being a loyal customer for years. Devs, please restore the old functionality and give us an option of vibrate-only alarms and push notifications that don't stop until you begin the routine!

reviews.title: It’s great. Pay them for their hard work if you find it useful.
reviews.text: NOTE: being mad an app isn’t free is like being mad restaurants aren’t free or your plumber isn’t free. I guarantee you that hundreds, if not thousands of hours went into making this app, and it’s updated constantly… which means they’re working on it all the time. If you value someone’s work, you should pay them for it. Having a concentration app shoving ads in your face constantly worlds kind of defeat the purpose, no? Regarding the app: I needed a relatively simple app to break my day into blocks of repeatable tasks (e.g. morning routine) and blocks of time where I could use my existing task management tools to get things done. This app is great for that. Not as rigid as Tiimo time-wise but it’s heavier on reminders. Tiimo ended up being a place where I could see whatever it was that I’d been falling to work on for the past hour… this does a better job of keeping me on track. Support (might be a one person project?) is responsive and useful. Syncing for the watch is excellent while in a routine (another thing Tiimo was terrible at)    -Wishes- Base Functionality: * Halfway reminders, or reminders every 𝑛 minutes would be super useful. While I’m working, I use an interval timer app that gives me a simple notification every six minutes. Having this integrated would be helpful. * would love a mode where I had a pile of tasks and a set block of time and I could choose which ones to do next. Sometimes it doesn’t matter if I shave before a brush my teeth but just need to be reminded to do both and stay on task. UI improvements: * Having text search of emoji would help. Doesn’t have to be any more complicated than a filter based on characters included in the name. Figuring out whether the icon I want is in default or whatever can be tedious. “Wait… was there a work category? No? Maybe electronics? No… hmmm” * Having sub-headings or details under title for tasks would be helpful. * Still not really sure what contexts are. My first guess is that they’d be like GTD contexts like “on the phone,” or “at work,” but that doesn’t really make sense for a scheduled task. Maybe that’s not the right word for the functionality? If so, some other wording could use cleanup— “you can restart at any time” implies that you’re starting from the beginning. Unless I’m not seeing the ability to restart, it should read “you can continue any time.” In think there are a few other minor ones but clearly not important enough to matter. * Would love to see a breakdown of how much time I allocated to each task in reality so I can adjust my schedule or habits. That is more important info to me than whether or not I completed the entire block exactly as prescribed. Thanks for making the app.

reviews.title: Pale skin is default for emojis
reviews.text:
Huge turn off for myself and others who have tan skin. This app does not let you change skin colour of the emojis either. In other apps you can long press hold to swap emojis out for a different skin colour and that’s not an option here. This is why apps use the default yellow skin versus pale Caucasian skin. While it’s not great that is more inclusive than just making Caucasian the default.
My review will remain 1 star until I see some sort of remedy for this as this was very offensive for my user experience to not be able to change emojis to represent myself in my own routine.

reviews.title: Changed My Life
reviews.text: I am normally not someone who leave reviews. However, I can say confidently that routinely has changed my life. As someone who runs chronically late, it has given me the ability to actually map out how much time I need to do certain things and project accurately what time I can be ready. Even just mapping out things after work and realistically how long they’ll take. 10/10!
